g.text: Do fraud transactions rise to the top?
AP: how clean is the fraud shortlist?
Sort transactions from highest to lowest fraud score.
AP rewards finding fraud early, before normal transactions fill the list.
Higher is better. AP = 1 means all fraud is ranked ahead of normal transactions.
ROC-AUC: does fraud usually get a higher score?
Pick one fraud and one normal transaction: which gets ranked higher?
0.5 is chance-level ranking; 1 is perfect ranking. Ties count as half.

svg.text: We prioritize AP: a high ROC-AUC can still leave investigators with many false alerts.
Implementation: sklearn average_precision_score and roc_auc_score. AP is not trapezoidal PR area.
